limitations: This is registry-listing evidence, not a documentation claim — it is trustworthy for the narrow fact of 'this image name and these tags exist and were pushed on these dates', but the Docker Hub page itself does not describe what the image's entrypoint does, whether it bundles the SQL DDL/Pydantic/SQLAlchemy generators, or whether it supports SVG/PNG rendering; those are separate capability questions not answered by a tag listing (see source-linkml-tooling.json for the documented absence of SVG/PNG export from gen-erdiagram, which applies regardless of packaging). The fetch was processed through an intermediate summarization tool rather than raw page capture, so the exact tag list should be treated as a faithful but not hash-verified transcription. No Dockerfile or image README was independently fetched in this pass to confirm the image's exact command surface (e.g. whether `linkml-lint`, `gen-sqlddl`, and `gen-project` are all present inside it) — this is recorded as an open gap.
provenance: Retrieved 2026-08-14 via automated web fetch of https://hub.docker.com/r/linkml/linkml/tags. Re-verify by re-fetching the same URL; publicly accessible without authentication. raw_evidence.quote: Each tag includes information about when it was pushed, compressed image size, and availability for both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 architectures.

docker_image_availability.rationale: An official-namespace image (linkml/linkml) is confirmed present on Docker Hub with a current tag (1.11.1, matching the most recent GitHub release) and a 'latest' tag, for both amd64 and arm64. This is verified directly against the public registry listing itself, not inferred from a README or blog claim, satisfying the brief's source_requirements for this fact. Whether the image's entrypoint exposes the specific generators needed (gen-sqlddl, Pydantic gen) and whether it can produce SVG/PNG were not confirmed from the registry page alone and are covered (negatively, for SVG/PNG) in source-linkml-tooling.json based on gen-erdiagram's documented output-format limitation.

contrary_evidence_search.result: General web search for a ghcr.io-hosted LinkML image returned no confirmed ghcr.io/linkml/... listing (only generic GHCR how-to articles unrelated to LinkML); Docker Hub search separately surfaced two other linkml-namespace images (linkml/semantic-sql and linkml/schema-automator) which are different, narrower tools last pushed roughly three years prior per their own tag pages — these are recorded as a separate, staler source family and not conflated with the actively-maintained linkml/linkml image confirmed above. No evidence was found of a second, independent official registry (e.g. ghcr.io) hosting the core linkml/linkml image; Docker Hub appears to be the sole confirmed distribution channel from this search pass.
